final_judge.note: Final judge used compact HiGHS single-journey reduced-cost pricing instead of enumerating every task-subset representative. It can certify no-negative only when the compact pricing MILP is exact and nonnegative; negative-feasibility phase may still return audited negative columns before exact closure.

branch_context.note: Exact branch feasibility context; guidance may rank candidates but cannot change these decisions.

cut_context.note: Exact cut coefficient context. Current runner records no active cuts by default.
